inject-rules.heading: SCOTT'S NEVER-FORGET RULES (from skill townreporter-release-path; obey every line, no exceptions):

requiredKeys.message: devServerRun: what ran on :3100 and the result
announcedAt: the time announced to Scott

mustEqual.message: testServerCommit must equal the sha (Test server must run this exact build)

deploy-gate.reportMustContainMessage: walk report must contain the line "PUBLISH-WALK: PASS"

textOnly.filesMessage: textFiles: the page files this text change touches
textOnly.extraMessage: not text-only; these files also changed:

deploy-gate.label: TownReporter
deploy-gate.pathLine: Path: branch -> dev server :3100 -> Test server :3400 FULL walk incl. Publish -> production.
deploy-gate.nextStep: Do the missing tier, then write the gate file.

bannedPatterns.pattern: do not (press )?publish|never (press )?publish|no publishing|do not publish, delete|don't (press )?publish
bannedPatterns.message: it bans publishing ("do not publish"). The Test server is a disposable copy: publishing there is the point.

requiredLines.message: it has no "PUBLISH-WALK: PASS or FAIL" closing line and no publish path.

requiredSections.message: it has no "EVERY DOOR:" section listing every place on the desk where each tested job can be done (for example Kill: Queue row button, X key, bulk strip, Today, Story page).

walk-brief-guard.footer: Every walk brief must have the walker press Publish for real on the Test server (draft -> Publish -> bar words -> Published list -> public page -> gone from Drafts) and end with the exact line PUBLISH-WALK: PASS or PUBLISH-WALK: FAIL.

db-write-guard.label: the live paper's database
db-write-guard.explanation: The live paper is read-only for me. Data changes go through the tested path (dev server -> Test server -> announced, backed-up deploy).

no-idle.waiterHint: Arm one in the background: bash C:/Users/scott/Desktop/Code/townreporter-deepseek-oversight/tools/wait-workers.sh <names>
no-idle.handledHint:
Act now: read runs\<name>\last.txt, START the next step (dev, Test walk, gate, deploy, or a fix worker),
  then write runs\<name>\handled.txt with one line: the time, and the next step you started.
no-idle.stuckHint: Diagnose and relaunch, or mark handled.txt if dead on purpose.

double-check.quote: Scott, Oct 14 2026: "Check everything twice, read everything, do not skim, check the code."
double-check.label: TownReporter

wake.label: TownReporter
wake.footer: Check every worker and server; start the next step for anything finished; relaunch anything stalled; report to Scott in 3 lines.
